name: old-actual-regression
argv:
import hashlib,importlib.machinery,importlib.util,json,sys,tools.quality,unittest
loader=importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader("tools.quality.godot",sys.argv[1])
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_loader(loader.name,loader)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name]=module
loader.exec_module(module)
if module.__file__!=sys.argv[1]:raise RuntimeError("wrong old module")
from tools.quality.test_quality import SelectionTests
case=SelectionTests("test_semantic_helpers_cannot_write_to_checkout_or_existing_directory")
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.TestSuite([case]))
observed={"tests_run":result.testsRun,"failures":len(result.failures),"errors":len(result.errors),"actual_old_mirror_failure":any("SameFileError" in trace for test,trace in result.errors),"test_id":case.id(),"old_sha256":hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read()).hexdigest()}
print("ACTUAL OLD TEST: "+json.dumps(observed),flush=True)
if result.testsRun!=1 or len(result.errors)!=1 or not observed["actual_old_mirror_failure"]:raise RuntimeError("not the required old regression outcome")
sys.exit(1)
